CONBUD

CONBUD is at 85 Delancey Street on the Lower East Side, with about 590 products from 92 brands, the larger of the two licensed dispensaries we track in the Chinatown and LES area. Pre-rolls are its biggest section by a wide margin at around 210 listings, followed by 138 edibles, 128 vapes and 86 flower options. It also lists nine topicals, more than most downtown shops.

Ruby Farms, a New York pre-roll and flower grower, leads the shelf with 40 listings, and Claybourne Co., Ayrloom, Mfused, Zips and Wizard Trees cover pre-rolls, drinks, edibles and flower. The lowest-priced listing is a $3 lighter; the entry price for cannabis is LEVEL tablet two-packs at $4. Mighty Lucky on the Bowery is the other licensed shop nearby, with a more edible-heavy menu of about 540 products.

Good to know
  • Largest menu in Chinatown and the LES: about 590 products and 92 brands, versus 540 at Mighty Lucky.
  • Pre-roll led, with about 210 listings and Ruby Farms the deepest line.
  • Nine topicals listed, a better selection than most downtown shops.
  • Cannabis prices start at $4 for LEVEL tablets; the $3 listing is a lighter.
CONBUD FAQ
CONBUD or Mighty Lucky — which should I visit?

CONBUD for pre-rolls and flower; it has about 210 pre-rolls to Mighty Lucky's 133 and nearly 90 flower options. Mighty Lucky is the stronger edible and tincture stop. They are a few blocks apart on Delancey and the Bowery, so visiting both is easy.

Which New York brands does CONBUD carry?

Ruby Farms is the deepest at 40 listings, and Claybourne Co., Ayrloom, Zips and Wizard Trees are all stocked. That gives the shop a strong local pre-roll and flower selection.

How do I get there?

CONBUD is at 85 Delancey Street, about a block from the Delancey Street-Essex Street station on the F, J, M and Z lines.
